expectations.text: Names the two CIA chips at $DC00 and $DD00
States KERNAL ROM at $E000 and BASIC ROM at $A000
Points sound to SID, sprites to VIC/sprites, joystick to control ports/CIA, disk to the disk topic
expectations.evidence: Sound → SID; Sprites → VIC-II; Joystick → CIA $DC00/$DC01; Disk drive → serial bus via CIA2 + KERNAL
